description.sr: Nastavnikov spisak i odobrenje objave fotografija trećeg časa, 21.10.2026; fotografski niz posete i sedam dodatnih fotografija iz dostavljenog Drive foldera.
description.en: Teacher’s participant list and permission to publish third-class photographs, 21 October 2026; the visit photo sequence and seven additional photographs from the supplied Drive folder.

summary.sr: Na praktičnim vežbama 16. oktobra prototipovi su stigli do korisnika udruženja. Prema belešci nastavnika, direktor je pohvalio studentske radove, korisnici su želeli da ih isprobaju, a pomenut je i mogući konkurs udruženja. Konkurs još nije najavljen.
summary.en: During the practical session on 16 October, the prototypes reached the association’s users. According to the teacher’s account, the director praised the student work, users wanted to try it, and a possible association competition was mentioned. No competition has been announced.

seen.sr: Više prototipova je na krilu, uz ruke koje pridržavaju okvir ili telo predmeta. U jednom kadru ruka je unutar okvira, a druga ga pridržava.
seen.en: Several prototypes rest on laps, with hands holding their frames or bodies. In one frame a hand is inside the frame while the other holds it.

next.sr: U narednom probanju proveriti da li predmet može stabilno da stoji dok jedna ruka istražuje. Uporediti sto i krilo; zabeležiti klizanje, hvat i potrebu za pomoći.
next.en: In the next trial, check whether the object stays stable while one hand explores it. Compare a table and a lap; record slipping, grip and any need for help.

seen.sr: Oko istog stola nalazi se više osoba. Štapići, oblici i kartice raspoređeni su po zajedničkoj površini. Fotografije ne pokazuju koja su pravila objašnjena niti ko ih je razumeo.
seen.en: Several people gather around the same table. Sticks, shapes and cards share one surface. The photographs do not show which rules were explained or who understood them.

next.sr: Probati raspored koji dopušta dohvat iz sedećeg položaja i sa različitih strana. Pitati učesnike da pokažu sledeći korak; razlikovati samostalno korišćenje od korišćenja uz objašnjenje.
next.en: Try a layout reachable while seated and from different sides. Ask participants to show the next step; distinguish independent use from use with an explanation.

title.en: Different grips on the same object

seen.sr: Kartonski prostorni prototip pojavljuje se u više položaja, sa rukama na različitim ivicama. Niz pokazuje različite načine držanja, ali ne meri lakoću korišćenja ili uspešnost zadatka.
seen.en: The spatial cardboard prototype appears in several orientations, with hands on different edges. The sequence shows different ways of holding it, but does not measure ease of use or task success.

next.sr: Obeležiti mesta hvata i posmatrati koja učesnici zaista biraju. Proveriti dohvat otvora i čvrstinu spojeva pri tim hvatovima, uz mogućnost da se probanje prekine.
next.en: Mark possible grip points and observe which ones participants actually choose. Check access to openings and the strength of joints with these grips, allowing the trial to stop at any time.
